plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Wildland Firefighting map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every fixed course, category, unit value and term total; the printed wording of choice-slot headings differs between the views on this map, so slot titles below use the Card View wording and each slot's note also gives its Table View wording. The inventoried program 'Wildland Firefighting' is listed in the mapper under that name; the program details state the student will be awarded an Associate of Science degree. This plan transcribes the first-listed 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Wildland Firefighting / Associate of Science / 60-61.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment, with no CSU course segment. The program's second 2026-2027 pathway ('to Degree', 60-61.5 units, 4 terms, term totals 15-16.5 / 15 / 14 / 16) uses the Bakersfield College general-education pattern and a different FIRE course order, and is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 both pathways existed in 6 terms at 60-61.5 units. The transcribed map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 14.5 / 14.5 / 16. The only ranged row is Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. FIRE B27B's title is printed '1-300 Incident Command System' (with the digit '1') in the map and is transcribed exactly as printed. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Wildland Firefighting exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
